mapper.sql: c.publication_status = 'PUBLISHED' and c.visibility = 'PUBLIC' and c.admission_status = 'PASSED' and c.is_duplicate = false and c.fact_status <> 'DEBUNKED' and c.provider_name is not null and lower(c.provider_name) not in ('mock', 'test', 'fixture')
mapper.select: select c.id, s.name as source_name, c.source_type, c.source_official_level, c.content_type, coalesce(c.title_zh, c.original_title) as title, c.original_title, c.summary_zh as summary, c.recommendation_reason, c.original_url, c.canonical_url, c.fact_status, c.final_score, c.featured, c.source_published_at, c.published_at from content.content_item c join source.source_entity s on s.id = c.source_entity_id where and c.published_at >= #{startAt} and c.published_at < #{endAt} order by c.featured desc, c.final_score desc nulls last, c.published_at desc, c.id desc limit #{limit}

select count(distinct c.id) as story_count, count(distinct cer.event_cluster_id) as event_count, count(distinct c.source_entity_id) as source_count, count(distinct c.source_entity_id) filter (where c.source_official_level in ('OFFICIAL', 'FIRST_PARTY')) as official_source_count, count(distinct c.id) filter (where c.featured) as featured_count from content.content_item c left join content.content_event_relation cer on cer.content_item_id = c.id where and c.published_at >= #{startAt} and c.published_at < #{endAt}
select max((c.published_at at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) from content.content_item c where

select issue.id, issue.period, issue.volume, issue.start_date, issue.end_date, issue.headline, issue.lead, issue.story_count, issue.event_count, issue.source_count, issue.official_source_count, issue.featured_count, issue.estimated_minutes from content.report_issue issue where issue.period = #{period} and issue.status = 'PUBLISHED' and exists ( select 1 from content.report_section section join content.report_item item on item.report_section_id = section.id join content.content_item c on c.id = item.content_item_id where section.report_issue_id = issue.id and ) and issue.start_date <= #{anchor} and issue.end_date >= #{anchor} order by issue.start_date desc, issue.id desc limit 1

select issue.start_date as anchor_date, issue.story_count, issue.headline as lead_title from content.report_issue issue where issue.period = #{period} and issue.status = 'PUBLISHED' and exists ( select 1 from content.report_section section join content.report_item item on item.report_section_id = section.id join content.content_item c on c.id = item.content_item_id where section.report_issue_id = issue.id and ) order by issue.start_date desc, issue.id desc limit #{limit}
select id, section_code, title, summary, sort_order from content.report_section where report_issue_id = #{issueId} order by sort_order, id

select c.id, s.name as source_name, c.source_type, c.source_official_level, c.content_type, coalesce(c.title_zh, c.original_title) as title, c.original_title, c.summary_zh as summary, c.recommendation_reason, c.original_url, c.canonical_url, c.fact_status, c.final_score, c.featured, c.source_published_at, c.published_at from content.report_item ri join content.content_item c on c.id = ri.content_item_id join source.source_entity s on s.id = c.source_entity_id where ri.report_section_id = #{sectionId} and order by ri.position, ri.id
